name: web/music
title: Music loop
summary: One HTML page that composes and plays a looping piece with the Web Audio API, no library and no internet: drums, bass, chords and melody in lo-fi, ambient, chiptune, house or felt-piano style, a step grid and a WAV download.
when: Use when the user wants music made: a lo-fi beat, a chiptune or ambient track, a piano melody, a game soundtrack. Not for a music player, a playlist of their files or a visualizer.

title.about: The name of the piece, above the controls and in the browser tab.

style.about: lofi, ambient, chiptune, house or piano. A whole sentence works; the first style word found is used.

tempo.about: Beats per minute as a plain number, for example 90; own takes the style's tempo.

key.about: The key, for example "A minor" or "C major"; own takes the style's key.

bars.about: How many bars the loop is, as a plain number, for example 8.

next: Nothing more to do: the page is finished and shows itself in the chat. Do not read it, run it, build it or install anything; tell the user in one or two sentences what the piece is and that Play starts it. Only when the user asks for a change: edit the plain lines at the top of index.html inside <script type="text/plain" id="settings"> with replace_in_file, one line per call.
change: Only the five lines at the top of index.html, inside <script type="text/plain" id="settings">, are edited: title, style, tempo, key, bars. One call per change, copying the old line exactly: replace_in_file(path="{file}", old="style lofi", new="style chiptune").
